grammar.explanation: 의지나 약속을 나타낸다. 경우가 많다. ‘-(으)ㄹ게요’ is attached to verbs to express the speaker's It can only be used when the subject is intention or promise to do something. the first person and cannot be used in questions. It is often used in response 받침 ○ -을게요 먹다 → 먹을게요 to someone else's request or command. 받침 ×, 받침 ‘ㄹ’ -ㄹ게요 가다 → 갈게요 예 제 가 빨래를 할게요. (O) 이반 씨가 빨래를 할게요. (X) 오후에 빨래를 걷을게요. 나 : 네, 내일 일찍 올게요.
